perspective:
Arthur’s available information/reconstruction:

- He is working with Teresa on a community service project. He notices Teresa appears to be working hard and overwhelmed; he becomes concerned, believes she needs help, and offers assistance.
- He hears Teresa say she thinks she can manage but has a lot to do. He tells her self-care is important and offers help so they can finish faster. She accepts if he insists and asks for help organizing medical supplies; they begin.
- Arthur interprets Teresa as hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability. He admires that and wants to reassure her. He tells her accepting help does not mean she is incapable. He hears her say she appreciates it and wants to show she can do it herself. He responds that teamwork is effective and it is about doing the job well. She agrees and says she needs to remind herself. He says they are in this together and he supports her.
- Arthur perceives Teresa as still struggling. He feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results and wants another way to support her without making her feel inadequate. He tells her he sees things are tough and she is doing great. She says it has been busy and she feels behind. He suggests working together rather than just helping her; she agrees; they tackle the tasks as a team.
- Arthur feels hopeful the collaborative approach will ease the burden and improve efficiency. He tells Teresa this; she says it already feels less overwhelming. He proposes he handle inventory while she manages patient records, checking in regularly. She agrees and is glad. He says he is too and wants a productive day.
- Arthur believes their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship and feels satisfied. He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off and they accomplished more together. She agrees and calls it a great experience. He proposes continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. She calls it fantastic and says they are efficient and effective as a team. He agrees and looks forward to their next project. She thanks him for being a supportive colleague.
